events.text: The Celts have started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: God-King ([ICON_BUILDING_PALACE] Palace provides +1 to these yields: [ICON_CULTURE], [ICON_PEACE], [ICON_GOLD], [ICON_PRODUCTION], [ICON_FOOD], [ICON_RESEARCH], [ICON_HAPPINESS_1])

Greece has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Dance of the Aurora (+1 [ICON_FOOD] Food and +1 [ICON_PEACE] Faith from Flat Tundra tiles without Forest, +1 [ICON_PEACE] Faith from Tundra Hill tiles without Forest)

Spain has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: God of the Sea (+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production from Fishing Boats and Atolls, a free Work Boat appears near the [ICON_CAPITAL] Capital)
The Aztecs have started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Oral Tradition (+1 [ICON_PEACE] Faith from Plantation Resources)
Germany has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: One with Nature (+5 [ICON_PEACE] Faith from Natural Wonders)

Greece has founded the new religion Buddhism in the holy city of Athens:[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Pilgrimage[ENDCOLOR] +2 [ICON_PEACE] Faith for each city following this religion[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Pagodas[ENDCOLOR] Allows you to build Pagodas with [ICON_PEACE] Faith (+1 [ICON_PEACE] Faith, +4 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture, +1 [ICON_HAPPINESS_1] Happiness)[NEWLINE][ICON_PEACE] Faith cost on Quick speed: Pagoda 150.
Rome has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Desert Hospitality (+1 [ICON_FOOD] Food and +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture from [ICON_BUILDING_CARAVANSARY] Caravansaries)
JAGUARRR has made peace with Achilles!
